started: We are preparing the installation for this server.
revealed: Install command. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
regenerated: We are preparing a new command for this server.
not_agent: This asset is not connected with a probe installed on the server.
not_ready: The install command is not ready yet, was already shown or has expired. If you did not get to copy it, generate a new one.
already_linked: That probe is already connected to another server. Generate a new command.
not_linked: The data received does not belong to this server. Nothing was saved.
group_mismatch: The data received belongs to another company. Nothing was saved.
unavailable: Server connections are not available in your account yet. We will let you know.
